title: Three Years and One Short Plan
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：street　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 street 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the planner ① sweeped the street that no citizen in the district would have counted, and he said the sweeping was the whole of the year. The ② street, meaning the road itself and not the plan, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a street, he said, is the only thing in a district that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ street in that district had the same short plan beside it, and the ④ street at the far square, meaning the plot they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A street, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the planner said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the street was the whole of the matter, meaning the life and not the road. The ⑥ street, meaning the life and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; street, he said, is either something you sweep or the only word that means both a road and a life. He said the life is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ street had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short plan. The ⑧ street of the whole thing, the planner wrote in March, was one district and three years of counting; street, he said, is either the plot at the far square or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ street I remember is the road counted in the report, which closed in 1994 and is still counted as the quietest in the district. A ⑩ street, my mother said in 1996, is the only road that improves by being counted; every street, she said, is a life that has agreed to look like a road. She said the life was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 街道（指街区里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 街道（指那条街道本身，与薄薄的图纸相对）
C. 固定搭配：sweep the street 扫这一条街道
D. n. 街道（指留给孩子们丈量的那一块）
E. n. 街道之事（抽象总称，指一处街区的街道之事）
F. n. 街道（指规划报告里写到、被清点的那一条）
G. n. 街道、市井（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 市井（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sweeped the street that no citizen in the district would have counted
The street, meaning the road itself and not the plan
the street at the far square
the street was the whole of the matter
the street had become a line in a report
The street of the whole thing
A street, my mother said in 1996

answers.why: sweep the street 意为“扫这一条街道”，1987 年那位规划员把街区里没有一位市民肯清点的一条街道做了一遍。
street 意为“街道”，指那条街道本身而不是薄薄的图纸，它经过了三个年份而在簿子上没有被清点。
street 意为“街道”，指街区里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一张薄薄的图纸。
street 意为“街道”，指最远那处广场的留给孩子们丈量的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
street 意为“街道、市井”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条市井就是那件事的全部。
street 意为“市井”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条街道，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
street 意为“街道”，指规划报告里写到、被清点的那一条，到 1992 年这一条成了规划报告里的一行。
street 意为“街道之事”，规划员三月写道，整件事的街道之事是一处街区和三个年份的清点。
street 意为“街道”，我记得的是规划报告里清点过的那一条，1994 年落成了，至今仍被说成街区里最安静的一条。
street 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，街道是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的街道。
